info.title: Wallet Ledger
info.description: INR wallet backend with bearer authentication and explicit SQL. Every POST requires a UUID Idempotency-Key, scoped to the authenticated caller. Identical retries return the saved status and JSON body with Idempotent-Replay: true. Changing the endpoint, resource or validated body with the same key returns 422. Concurrent duplicates wait up to five seconds; a still-busy key returns 409. Business failures are saved; validation, authentication and infrastructure failures are not.

post.description:
Post a peer payment or withdrawal from an owned wallet. Admins may top up or charge fees.

Amounts are integer paise. Top-up needs destination_account_id; withdrawal and fee need
source_account_id; peer needs both. System endpoints are resolved by the server.

finding_count counts raw invariant violations; problem_count compares ledger and caches
against posted business events. A single damaged entry can violate several invariants.
The run returns passed, failed (integrity problems), or error (checks could not complete).
